category.label: sycophancy
category.description: Praise aimed at the reader instead of the work.

source: avoid-ai-writing by Conor Bronsdon (MIT) and Ryan Yannelli's house rules

patterns.show: `That's a great point`, `That's an excellent point`, `That's a fantastic idea`, `That's a really good observation`, `That's an insightful observation`

patterns.phrase: thank you for (?:sharing|bringing this|pointing|the clarification|your patience)

patterns.show: `You raise a great point`, `You raise an excellent point`, `You raise a good point`, `You raise a valid point`, `You raise an important point`

patterns.phrase: I apologize for (?:the|any) (?:confusion|oversight|inconvenience)|apologies for the confusion|my apologies
